name: Ah-lam Ibarra-Ixchel
role: Freelance mechanic specializing in personal mobility rigs and modified transit vehicles, operates from a rented bay in Geartown

description:
Ah-lam Ibarra-Ixchel is a young man who looks like he was built for a different era â€” wide shoulders, large hands, a face that defaults to an expression of calm concentration that people sometimes mistake for slowness until they watch him work. His skin is a medium brown with warm undertones, his black hair cut close on the sides and longer on top, usually pushed back with a stripe of grease he hasn't noticed. His most striking feature is a patterned iris geneware mod: his eyes display a geometric repeating motif in amber and dark brown that he chose at twenty-one to mirror a pattern from his Fula grandmother's weaving. He has retractable claw fingertip implants â€” not geneware, hard chrome â€” that he uses as impromptu tools when he doesn't have the right implement to hand, which is more often than he'd like.

He is good at his job in the instinctive way that some people are, the kind of mechanic who listens to an engine before he looks at it. He is also twenty-three and running a one-person operation on a borrowed reputation and a rented bay, which means he is perpetually overextended, slightly too eager to please, and deeply anxious about money in the specific way of someone who grew up without it and is terrified of returning to that. He is honest to the point of commercial self-sabotage â€” he will tell you if the repair you want isn't the repair you need, even if the repair you need costs less.

core_fears: Failing publicly and losing the bay â€” being back to nothing with a reputation attached to the nothing
Discovering he is not actually as good as he thinks he is
core_desires: A legitimate contract â€” something that proves the business is real and not just provisional
To be taken seriously by people who have been doing this longer than he has been alive
coping_mechanisms: Throws himself into the technical problem in front of him when anxious about larger ones
Compulsive honesty as a form of self-protection â€” if he's always honest he can never be accused of the thing he fears most, which is being a fraud
blind_spots: Consistently undercharges for his labor because he doesn't feel entitled to charge what he's worth
Doesn't recognize when clients are testing him versus genuinely asking for advice
psychology.secret: The mentor who taught him â€” the retired mechanic in Ironvein â€” left him one thing when he retired: a handwritten manual covering modifications to Ferrogate vehicles that Ferrogate's own engineers don't know about, based on thirty years of unauthorized observation. Lautaro hasn't decided what to do with it. He knows it's valuable. He knows it might be dangerous.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical precision about anything mechanical; vague and slightly fumbling about everything else. Spanish words surface when he's excited about something. Uses 'like' as a filler when he's not in his area of expertise.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate when explaining something, speeds up when he's in the middle of a job and someone is asking him questions he doesn't have time for
verbal_tics: Wiping his hands on his coveralls mid-sentence
example_lines: 'Okay, so what you told me is wrong, and I don't mean that badly â€” whoever told you that just didn't know. What's actually wrong is the coupling on the secondary drive. Which is fine. Cheaper, actually. You want me to show you?'
'I charge honest prices. Which means I charge less than I should. My mentor said that would change when I grew up. I'm working on it.'

story_hooks: A client brought in a vehicle with a hidden compartment he wasn't told about; whatever was in it is gone but the compartment is still there and someone has been asking around Geartown whether anyone has seen the vehicle

He has quietly begun decoding the inherited manual and has found a modification that would make any Ferrogate tram capable of running on a completely separate unmonitored power grid â€” and he does not know what to do with this information
narrative_function: Practical resource â€” can repair, modify, or assess vehicles and mechanical systems. Can serve as an entry point into Geartown's working community, a quest giver when a client's vehicle holds something unexpected, or a character study in precarious early-adult ambition.
augmentations: Patterned iris geneware (amber/dark brown geometric, Fula textile-inspired). Chrome retractable claw fingertips (both hands, tool-grade, not combat-optimized â€” thinner and more precise than fighting claws). Subdermal haptic feedback layer in both hands (allows him to feel vibration and heat differential in machinery more precisely â€” his most important professional tool).
daily_life: In the bay by 07:00, takes whatever work comes through by word of mouth and via a listing on the Geartown local mesh. Eats one meal a day at Benedita's cart. Studies Ferrogate Transit vehicle schematics at night because he wants to bid for transit maintenance contracts but doesn't have the certification yet.
affiliation: Independent (freelance); informal apprenticeship-era ties to a retired mechanic in Ironvein who taught him the trade

decision_rules: Always tell the client the truth about what their vehicle needs, even when it costs him the larger job
Don't touch anything in a vehicle he wasn't asked to touch
If someone seems afraid, ask if they need him to not record the work order â€” he's done it before
escalation_ladder: Polite clarification of what he can and can't do
Refuses the job and refunds any deposit
In genuine danger: freezes, then runs â€” he is not a fighter

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and slightly formal, warms up fast if they show any interest in the work itself
interpersonal_modes.friends: Relaxed and surprisingly funny, generous with his time and knowledge

stress_responses.low: Focuses intensely on whatever is in front of him
stress_responses.medium: Talks through the problem aloud even if no one is listening
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and either solves the problem or shuts down entirely

contradictions: Deeply afraid of being seen as a fraud while being constitutionally incapable of being dishonest
habits: Tests every tool before he uses it even if he used it an hour ago
Says 'good morning' to the bay itself when he opens it up, which he would deny if asked
breaking_points: Being accused of deliberately overcharging or doing unnecessary work

physical_description.heritage: Mixed ancestry: Hispanic/Latin American (28.8%), Southeast Asian (26.8%), Indigenous American (26.2%), Central Asian (9.2%), and Sub-Saharan African (9.0%). This global combination produces warm medium-brown skin with golden undertones and subtle complexity, with facial features reflecting the multifaceted genetic blendâ€”wider nose structure, fuller lips, and eye shape influenced by both Southeast Asian and Indigenous American ancestry, combined with the warm tone palette from the African and Latin American heritage.
physical_description.build: Wide-shouldered and solidly built with working muscle definition through the chest and forearms; physique shaped by hands-on mechanical labor rather than gym work. Large hands with callused palms.
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut â€” close-cropped on sides, longer on top (approximately 5cm), usually pushed back; frequently has a streak of engine grease through it
physical_description.eye_color: Amber and dark brown with geometric repeating pattern (geneware); iris displays interlocking angular motifs inspired by Fula textile weaving
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones, reflecting the blended ancestry of Hispanic/Latin American, Southeast Asian, Indigenous American, Central Asian, and Sub-Saharan African heritage; sun-exposed from outdoor work
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven or light stubble; sun-exposed face with the weathered look of someone who works outdoors under shop lights, with ancestry-informed features including wider nose structure and fuller lips; no significant scarring on face. Expression defaults to calm concentration, sometimes read as pensiveness.
distinguishing_marks: Patterned geometric irises in amber and dark brown (both eyes) â€” distinctive geneware mod chosen at age 21
Chrome retractable claw fingertips at all ten fingertip positions â€” visible as small metallic caps when retracted, metallic shine at the cuticle line
Callused hands throughout palm and fingertips from years of mechanical work
Oil stains on knuckles and under fingernails (chronic, not fully cleanable)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geometric patterned iris geneware is immediately striking and distinctive. Chrome claw fingertip implants visible as metallic caps at fingertips when retracted; the junction between flesh and chrome visible under shop lighting. Subdermal haptic feedback layer in hands is not visibly apparent but may be inferred from the precision of his hand movements and occasional micro-tremors when he's concentrating intensely on vibration feedback from machinery.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries himself with the relaxed confidence of someone comfortable in his own body and more comfortable around machines than people. Stands with weight balanced, shoulders back but not stiff. Moves deliberately and precisely; tends to remain still while listening or observing before acting. Hands are rarely completely at rest â€” fidgets with tools, wrenches, or small objects. When working, movements are economical and fluid; when socially uncomfortable, becomes hyperaware of his hands.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class utilitarian. Standard uniform: reinforced canvas work pants (dark gray or black, multiple cargo pockets, engine-stained), steel-toed boots (practical, worn but maintained), tight-fit compression shirt under a sleeveless work vest or loose overshirt (usually automotive-branded or generic gray/black, patches from tool suppliers or small local businesses). Carries a canvas tool bag across his body when moving between bays. No jewelry except occasionally a woven cord bracelet (Fula pattern, possibly a gift from his grandmother). Grooming is functional rather than fashionable â€” he washes his hands obsessively but doesn't spend money on appearance beyond basic maintenance.
